name: 98682 · Vancouver, WA
findings: ZIP 98682 (Vancouver) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98682 (Vancouver) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98682 (Vancouver) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
